Tailscale is the most comfortable software I've used in years. Underneath it's just WireGuard, but almost nobody else has made the user experience this good. The free tier covers nearly everything, and like Cloudflare it's practically a saint. Then there are exit nodes and so many advanced, fun tricks.

It shows that wrapping complex technology into a product that's easy to use is a huge amount of value in itself.

Whenever it goes public, I'm rushing to support it.
